info.name: Have I Been Pwned API v3 Breach Breacheddomain API
Get all breached email addresses for a domain

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain to be searched for. Must be a verified domain in the domain search dashboard.

items.docs: Available on Core and Pro subscriptions. Returns all breached email aliases on a verified domain and the breach names they have appeared in. The domain must already have been added to the domain search dashboard and successfully verified. Sensitive breaches are returned because this API is only available after domain control has been demonstrated.
